law.catch_line: Question to be printed on ballots
law.text: The question to be printed on the ballots used in any referendum held under this article shall be as follows: "Do you favor additional market development, education, publicity, research, and promotion of the Virginia horse industry and continuation of the levy of an assessment of $1.50 on each equine infectious anemia test performed on samples collected in Virginia in accordance with the provisions of the Horse Industry Board law? _____ Yes _____ No."
